patch_description: I am upgrading the ansatz to use a "SU(2) rotation sequence" (RX, RY, RZ) on each qubit, which significantly enhances the circuit's expressivity compared to the previous RY-RZ-only setup. To keep the parameter count manageable and prevent overfitting (as evidenced by the low generalization gap requirement), I continue using coarse-grained parameter sharing across the two halves of the register (qubits 0-3 and 4-7). I maintain the highly effective interleaved CZ ring entanglement structure combined with inter-group cross-chords, which ensures consistent global entanglement across all uploads. This configuration increases the per-block parameter count to 8, leading to a total of 50 circuit parameters, striking a better balance between expressivity and optimization stability.
